annotations.title: Inspect an MPP HTTP 402 challenge without paying

description: Inspect an MPP HTTP 402 challenge without paying. Use when an agent is about to pay an HTTP 402 resource that uses Machine Payments Protocol challenges (WWW-Authenticate: Payment) and needs the method, intent, amount, currency, recipient, expiry and any malformed field first. No credential is sent. Cost: 1 credit per call.

method.description: GET (the default) or POST. A POST is sent only when a GET of the same URL already answered with a payment challenge, or the site's own /openapi.json declares a paid POST at that path, and always with an empty body. Otherwise the GET's answer is returned and post_skipped is true.

url.description: The public http(s) resource to inspect.

name: mpp_inspect
